timeline.event: Implementation session started reading the fresh project.
First write: .expo-fast/brief.json after broad dependency and sibling-project discovery.
TodayScreen was written after types, theme, icons/UI/charts, utilities, storage, state and both forms.
MineScreen completed the four requested screens.
App.tsx finally connected the generated product.
The agent rewrote the stacked chart late in the turn.
The runner interrupted the implementation at the hard deadline.

stageAnalysis: The prompt requested a vertical skeleton in the first third, but the agent's brief chose types→theme→icons/UI/charts→utils→storage→state→forms→screens→app-shell.
About eight minutes elapsed before the brief and more than twelve minutes before the first requested screen, so the observed path repeated the known bottom-up failure mode.
The 59 Reads, 53 Globs and 17 Greps dominate the 23 Writes; cache-read usage reached 9.46 million tokens in the main turn.
The late chart rewrite and continued cross-project inspection consumed the remaining budget instead of stopping after the runnable product was connected.
caveats: The main result is an orchestration SIGINT/error at the 20-minute limit, not a normal model stop.
The later result.json records recovery invocations and must not be used to rewrite the original cold-start outcome as PASS.
API duration, runner wall time, manual runtime diagnosis and UI evaluation are different clocks and are reported separately.
